Hotel Sadan

A 20-room hotel in Lakeside, Pokhara. Stay a short walk from Fewa Lake, in a room with its own balcony, with a restaurant and bar downstairs.

Book your stay See the rooms

A calm base in the middle of Lakeside

Hotel Sadan is on 19th Street in Lakeside, Pokhara-06, between Khahare Chowk and Dihikopatan Road. It opened in 2021 and has 20 rooms, which keeps the hotel quiet and the service personal.

Walk to Fewa Lake in about ten minutes, then come back to an air-conditioned room, a hot meal and a front desk that is open all day and night. Our team can help you arrange tours, tickets, bike or car hire and currency exchange.

We welcome couples, families, solo travellers and groups. Children of all ages are welcome.

  • Fewa Lake, about 1 kmLakeside's cafes, shops and paragliding operators are close by.
  • Pokhara Airport, about 3 kmA short taxi ride. We can arrange pick-up on request.
  • Free parkingPrivate parking on site for guests, with car charging available.
  • Front desk 24 hoursArrive late or leave early. Someone is always there.

Rooms with a private balcony

Every room is air-conditioned and has its own bathroom. Choose a double bed or twin beds, and ask for a mountain or city view when you book.

Deluxe Double Room with private balcony

One double bed, a desk for working or planning the day, and a balcony for your morning tea. Suited to couples and solo travellers.

  • Double bed
  • Private balcony
  • Air conditioning
  • Flat-screen TV
  • Free WiFi
  • Private bathroom

Deluxe Twin Room with private balcony

Two single beds with the same balcony, desk and comforts. A good fit for friends, colleagues or a parent travelling with a child.

  • Twin beds
  • Private balcony
  • Air conditioning
  • Flat-screen TV
  • Free WiFi
  • Private bathroom

In-room extras include a work desk, safe, minibar and kettle. For current rates, call or message us and we will quote you directly.

Eat and drink without leaving the hotel

Our restaurant serves Nepali dishes along with Indian, Italian, Asian and international favourites. There is also a bar, and a BBQ area where guests can cook their own meal.
